description: This file defines the AppRegistryClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS Service Catalog App Registry service. It includes method annotations for various API operations and extends the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: AppRegistryClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Service Catalog App Registry, providing methods for managing application and attribute group resources.

methods.name: associateAttributeGroup
methods.description: Associates an attribute group with an application.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application in the AWS Service Catalog App Registry.
